# Streambench full documentation

Source: https://streambench.trfny.com/

Description: Complete LLM-oriented description of Streambench and its public discovery surfaces.

## Application

Streambench is a browser-based workshop for IPTV, internet radio, HLS, M3U/M3U8 playlists and XMLTV EPG. Local playlist files, pasted playlists, XMLTV data, edits, favorites, hidden items and history stay in the browser.

### Playback and playlists

- Open local or pasted M3U/M3U8 playlists.
- Play supported video and audio streams.
- Use native HLS or the bundled HLS implementation where needed.
- Inspect playlist metadata, logos, tags and stream diagnostics.
- Search, edit, hide, favorite and export entries locally.
- Import XMLTV for programme metadata.

### Public provider APIs

The Worker exposes constrained provider catalog/playlist APIs used by the UI. `/api/providers` describes available providers. These routes intentionally do not expose a general fetch proxy or arbitrary signing surface.

### Agent access

On browser hosts implementing WebMCP, Streambench exposes `read_stream_state`, `search_streams`, `start_stream_playback` and `stop_stream_playback`. Tools operate on the existing UI state and loaded playlist.
